name: level-8-execution-ladder
purpose: Allow autonomous work to advance through numbered gates 1,2,3,4... without treating planning as proof.

gates.name: inspect
gates.exit: repository state, scope and constraints recorded

gates.name: prioritize
gates.exit: next bounded task selected with rationale

gates.name: test
gates.exit: relevant automated verification executed or explicitly BLOCKED/ENVIRONMENT

gates.name: accessibility
gates.exit: keyboard, speech and braille evidence recorded independently

gates.name: release-gate
gates.exit: all required dimensions satisfy the fail-closed release contract

gates.name: next
gates.exit: next numbered task is deterministically selected

stop_only_when: all required dimensions are VERIFIED or PROVEN
security gate is VERIFIED or PROVEN
accessibility gate is VERIFIED or PROVEN
